adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The ICU family-conference behavior explicitly maps to VALUE: Value family statements, Acknowledge emotions, Listen, Understand the patient as a person, and Elicit questions.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NURSE is an emotion-response framework, SPIKES is a bad-news protocol, Best Case/Worst Case is scenario-based treatment planning, and CUS is team safety escalation. None reproduces the full VALUE family-conference sequence.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Every component of the mnemonic is instantiated in the stem, making the framework directly identifiable without relying on vague empathy cues.
